Similarly, the odds of the S&P 500 hitting 8,200 or higher stood at 27%, down from 54% in mid-August. The possibility of the market barometer breaching 8,400 stood at nearly 16%.
Meanwhile, markets assigned a 17% chance that the S&P 500 would close above 8,000 on Dec. 31, compared with a 13% chance it would close between 7,600 and 7,799.99.
The S&P 500 is a stock market index that tracks 500 of the largest publicly traded companies in the U.S. and serves as the barometer of overall U.S. economic health.
Year to date, it has rallied 12%, while growth over the past month has eased to 0.87%. The index reached a record close of 7,798.99 in mid-August. It rose 0.46% to close at 7,666.60 on Wednesday.
